lines.say: Good day or bad day. For one kind of person, both are good.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said:
How wonderful is the case of a believer; there is good for him in everything.
lines.cap: How wonderful is the case of a believer…

lines.say: If prosperity attends him, he expresses gratitude to Allah, and that is good for him.
And if adversity befalls him, he endures it patiently, and that is better for him.
Gratitude on the good days. Patience on the hard ones.
Live like that, and no day of yours is wasted.
Save this, and send it to someone who needs it today.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone who needs it 🤍

h1.ar:
عجبا لأمر المؤمن
إن أمره كله له خير
h1.tr: “How wonderful is the case of a believer; there is good for him in everything.”

h2.ar:
إن أصابته سراء شكر
فكان خيراً له
h2.tr: “If prosperity attends him, he expresses gratitude to Allah and that is good for him.”

h3.ar:
وإن أصابته ضراء صبر
فكان خيراً له
h3.tr: “If adversity befalls him, he endures it patiently and that is better for him.”

endcard: Save this for every kind of day
